meta_data.base_class: Calculate potential greenhouse gas emissions saved by switching to <a specific renewable energy source>. This is a general tool that uses the `energy_type` parameter. Subclass tools will be hardcoded to a specific source (e.g., solar, wind) and will remove the `energy_type` parameter.

tool_template.name: calculate_<class>_emission_savings
tool_template.description: Calculate potential greenhouse gas emissions saved by switching to <class>.

region.description: The region where you use <class> energy.

installation_cost.description: The initial cost of installing <class> in the region, in USD.

maintenance_frequency.description: The frequency of maintenance required for <class> in years.

average_output_efficiency.description: The average output efficiency of <class> in percentage over its lifetime.

carbon_intensity_of_alternative.description: The carbon intensity in kg CO2e/kWh of the alternative energy source being replaced by <class>.
